_readme: Reference specs for the authored cars (docs/carDesign.md). Each car blends two real donors: their dimensions in mm (sourced; `estimates` lists the keys read off side profiles rather than spec sheets), blend weights, what to take from each, and the lamp signatures. Nothing here is a game dimension: targets are derived as blend(donor value / donor wheelbase) x the car's manifest wheelbase x the `house` multiplier, so the proportions come from the donors and the stylization lives in one place. Readers: scripts/auditCar.ts (npm run audit, headless on the shipped GLB) and scripts/blender/carRefs.py (spec_check in Blender); scripts/blender/carFeatures.py builds the shared features from `house.features`. A calibrated side photo in assets/refs/<carId>/refs.json overrides the estimated keys.

house._scale: Street Scene proportions on top of the blended donors: one 0.28 m wheel for every car, wider (flares) and lower (chopped roof) than real. Measured off the Proto Hatch as shipped. Change here, re-audit every car, and say so: the manifest geometry feeds the sim.

features._: Every number is car space meters at the house scale. Builders in scripts/blender/carFeatures.py read these, so one edit changes every car.

pillars.quarterGlass: hatches only, behind the C pillar

protoHatch.brief: Five door hot hatch: the WRX hatch's stance, tall arches and flares with the Golf R's squared-off, tidy surfacing and detailing.

donors.name: 2010 Subaru Impreza WRX hatchback (GH)
take: stance: tall arches and wide flares (the house flares come from here)
teardrop headlights sweeping back along the fender top
wide low trapezoid grille with a slim upper slot (stock keeps both small)
tall taillight units at the D pillar that wrap onto the tailgate
hood scoop is a part (Hayate hood); the stock hood stays plain

donors.name: 2012 Volkswagen Golf R (Mk6)
take: squared-off surfacing: flat hood, upright tailgate, one crisp shoulder crease
LED strip along the bottom of the headlight (the Light indicator strip)
honeycomb lower intakes implied by Black patches, thin upper grille bar
thin horizontal taillight bar across the tailgate joining the quarter units
roof spoiler extending the roof line (a part)

body.roofline: flat roof to a steep tailgate; the D pillar carries a small quarter glass

front.notes: WRX teardrop in a Black housing, Golf R strip along the bottom

rear.notes: WRX hatch tall units at the D pillar wrapping the corner, Golf R bar across the tailgate

protoCompact.brief: Three door hatchback coupe: the 318ti's long doors, quarter windows and chopped-off short tail with the RSX's long swept lamps and flatter fastback glass.

donors.name: 1999 BMW 318ti Compact (E36/5)
take: short tail: the hatch drops almost straight behind the rear axle
flat glass cover over twin round lamps
small twin kidney grilles
L shaped taillights wrapping from the quarter onto the tailgate
long doors with a quarter window behind the B pillar

donors.name: 2003 Acura RSX (DC5)
take: long swept headlight covers climbing the fender
fastback: the rear glass lies flatter than a hatch's
slim mouth under a body colour bumper bar, no big grille
clean sides with one shoulder crease
taillights with a clear inner element (the Light block)

body.roofline: roof falls into a flatter fastback glass, then the tail is cut short behind the axle

front.notes: 318ti twin rounds under an RSX-long cover that climbs the fender

rear.notes: 318ti L units wrapping onto the tailgate with the RSX's clear inner block

protoCoupe.brief: Front engined coupe: the Supra's long hood, short deck and rounded greenhouse on the E46 M3's flared arches, kidneys and L line tail.

donors.name: 1999 Toyota Supra twin turbo (JZA80)
take: long hood, short deck, rounded greenhouse
quad projectors under one swept cover
big open lower mouth (stock keeps it small)
twin round taillights per side on a dark panel
hoop wing (a part)

donors.name: BMW M3 coupe (E46)
take: flared arches with a side gill behind the front wheel
power dome hood is a part; the stock hood is flat
small kidneys and slim angular lamp covers
L line taillights
twin tips per side are a part; stock keeps one tip per side

body.roofline: low rounded cabin, fastback into a short trunk lid

front.notes: E46 slim wedge cover with the Supra's twin projectors inside

rear.notes: Supra twin rounds on a dark panel set in the E46's L line

protoWagon.brief: Five door super wagon, the longest car in the garage: the RS 6 Avant's reduced donor body (long low roof, blistered arches, big intakes, diffuser with oval tips) wearing the V60 Polestar's hammer headlight graphics and C-shaped tail lamps climbing the D pillars. Front twin turbo V8, all wheel drive.

donors.name: 2020 Audi RS 6 Avant (C8)
take: the whole body: reduced to the budget, widened x1.06, dropped onto the house wheel, arches pulled in, roof chopped to 1.25 m
front and rear bumpers: big side intakes, single frame grille backing, diffuser with oval tips
its lamp lenses as the dark housings the V60 graphics sit in

donors.name: 2020 Volvo V60 T8 Polestar Engineered
take: headlight graphics: the hammer DRL and lens, laid into the RS 6 housings
tail lamps: the C shape climbing the D pillar, laid onto the RS 6 tail
the amber blinker at the outer end of each headlight

body.roofline: long roof falling to a raked tailgate glass; quarter glass behind the rear door

front.notes: V60 hammer DRL graphic in the RS 6 housing, grafted from the donor model (carDonors.graft), not built by carFeatures.lamps

rear.notes: V60 C lamps climbing the D pillar on the RS 6 tail, grafted from the donor model
